pattern_rationale: MediCore EHR provides a structured REST API over HTTP with JSON endpoints for patients and conditions. Wrapping it with an API facade translates records on demand without duplicating data storage.

alternatives_considered.why_not: Direct database access is not provided or exposed; the system already offers an official HTTP REST API.
MediCore EHR does not drop periodic batch files; data is available interactively via API.
The source system does not emit real-time event message feeds (e.g., HL7 v2 or webhooks).

sync.detail: On-demand request conversion when incoming client requests hit the FHIR facade API.

field_map.transform: Wrap string in list as given name
Convert date format from MM/DD/YYYY to YYYY-MM-DD
Map non-empty phone to object: {'system': 'phone', 'value': contact.phone}. Omit empty contact.email.
Wrap line1 in array if present
Construct CodeableConcept using SNOMED URI: {'coding': [{'system': 'http://snomed.info/sct', 'code': code.value, 'display': code.text}]}
Direct string mapping (already YYYY-MM-DD standard date)

risks: Lack of incremental sync / modifiedSince parameters on source API endpoints may force full table scans across paginated API responses.
US date parsing (MM/DD/YYYY) on Patient.dob could fail if source provides ambiguous or malformed date inputs.
Unmapped single-character 'sex' or 'state' values from backend updates could lead to transformation failures.
human_review_points: Confirm with MediCore EHR team if patient/condition endpoints support filtering by MRN or modified date query parameters.
Verify whether contact.email should be excluded completely or if future backend releases will populate this field.
Check if alternative values for gender/sex ('U', 'O', etc.) exist in the source system schema.
